issue.title: [GEO5] Reconcile complete North America operational gap batch
issue.body:
# Complete North America operational gap batch — GEO5

Parent campaign: #1202. This is the single batch tracker for the complete existing GEO5 operational batch; no per-family or per-gap issues. It contains 4,674 exact component IDs across 152 complete families, all in Northern America (Canada, Greenland, United States).

## Frozen scope

- Operational batch: `gap-operational-batch:a10b27469a42da1ecbfe0956`
- Exact component count: 4,674; complete family count: 152
- Ordered component-ID roster SHA-256: `ef459cecde35ac3c9c3741f07dec0355c4e66d1b6c58b019d87be36a6372d2ba`
- Source routing ledger: commit `43b064f0fb7a6711489d2a075a748aec596491d4`; all 14 complete `families-*.bin.gz` source files are pinned in the evidence contract.
- Current accepted funnel: PR #1483 merge `c8df65e1d5c4d235c33e2f488c3e29d26223860f`; the complete catalog leaves are pinned in the evidence contract.

The exact component roster is the ordered union of `complete_component_ids` from every family row with this exact `operational_batch` value. The issue evidence subjects below are the 152 complete family IDs; the committed candidate-level disposition table must contain each component ID exactly once and reproduce the roster hash. Do not infer candidate inclusion from the aggregate extent.

## Existing decisions and ownership

The global funnel currently classifies all 4,674 subjects as unresolved, with zero accepted classes, repair-ready cases, implementations, integrations or verified deliveries. Its provisional land/water evidence is retained as provisional. The table must record, per component, the accepted-class, source-fitness, implementation, integration, delivery and next-prerequisite states separately.

Reuse and preserve existing work. The source-only USA #1377 / PR #1384 (31 subjects) and BC #1362 / PR #1378 (43 subjects) conclude source-history unresolved. Alaska #1488 and measurement #1508 cover 13 other subjects; current engineering #1620 retains those 13. The active #1394 engineering claim covers 97 subjects. Preserve these owners and exact outputs; do not duplicate their work or change their scope. Reconcile all other linked issues and active claims against the exact candidate/family roster.

## Research and acceptance

1. Deliver one source-pinned table covering all 4,674 exact component IDs, with family ID, current funnel state, provisional support, exact source/candidate binding, accepted or existing issue status, and exact next prerequisite. Preserve unresolved rows as unresolved; source-relative support is not physical approval, repair readiness or integration.
2. Reuse the merged funnel, routing, physical-comparison and existing regional source packets. Investigate only the 23 remaining candidates whose current next prerequisite is source-fitness review before processing reproduction. Record the documented purpose, vintage, source lineage/license, unique compatible existing location, land support and relevant uncertainty for each exact ID. Do not rerun global GIS or acquire alternative sources.
3. State one reusable fit-for-reference rule with exact premises. Send only candidates meeting that rule to Engineering for original-processing reproduction, with exact IDs and immutable evidence locators. Preserve source dates, authority limits, water/ice uncertainty and historical questions without turning them into unstated claims. No geometry repair, canonical change, publication or deployment is in scope.
4. Preserve the 97 #1394 subjects, 13 #1620 subjects, and all previously reviewed or integrated candidates in the same complete roster table; reflect their actual current owner/status without editing their packets.
5. Complete normal exact-head review, issue readback/closure and workspace cleanup after the deliverable is accepted.

First recorded: 2026-10-09 America/Los_Angeles.

### Next repair-enabling fact after merged #1653

The four AleutiansWest operands match retained GSHHG2.3.7 WVS/level1/river_lake0 and 2018 geoBoundaries USA ADM2 metadata. Existing exact thirteen-case rule registration excludes them; that roster extension is engineering work, not new scientific evidence. Resolve only the demonstrated actual consumed administrative source-variant question: identify complete retained source-product/feature bytes, metadata edition, simplification/normalization recipe where retained, and the literal original approved source-relative rule predicate used by pilot/Alaska. Do not demand simplified geometry equal unsimplified catalogue geometry if the literal rule does not require it. Compare exact retained role/recipe/feature custody, distinguish a genuine differing/missing predicate from a mere unregistered roster, and propose the smallest reusable source-product-relative extension or precise exception. Current selected-owner/preimage/native qualification and conservation belong to engineering.

Reuse original quartet candidate/physical/query/source results and preserve all4,674 exact-ID dispositions. No new GIS/source/native operators, replacement sources, second global audit, physical water/land/date/legal authority or repair claims. Existing five merged outputs, provenance, source limits, all original machine evidence pins/subjects and owned namespace remain unchanged. The second PR estimate permits only this bounded continuation; if all needed facts already exist in merged operands, return exact pointers/conclusion immediately rather than generating duplicate outputs. Normal claim/review/queue/readback/owned cleanup applies to new substantive packet work.


### Demonstrated missing predicate: four first-time variant coverage checks

The retained quartet source-rule investigation identifies an actual missing fact: retainedCountySourcePremises requires each candidate covered by BOTH the full and simplified 2018 county variants and source_variants_same_for_this_candidate; merged1653 supplies no per-case results for those two variants. It requires agreement for this candidate, not identical whole full/simplified geometry. This is distinct from the thirteen-ID roster registration and justifies one bounded first-time check.

Authorize only the four exact1653 candidates against their two already retained9469f09 USA ADM2 variants, using the unchanged literal existing coverage predicate/geometry method and actual complete immutable source/candidate/code custody. Reuse already established physical/GSHHG/current-target evidence; do not replay those operators or any other candidates. Fresh whole-input/decoded/metadata/runtime/execution/output prospective admission and original32MiB-member/256MiB-phase/512-descriptor operating safeguards apply before execution; preserve failures and true command/runtime/time/output provenance. Produce four actual full-variant and simplified-variant coverage outcomes plus precise predicate conclusion, not an approval flag or inferred physical current truth. Normal source-only claim/evidence/review/integration/readback remains required. The original4674/152 denominator, all other outcomes, pins, namespace and engineering-only roster/native/selected responsibilities remain unchanged. This narrowly supersedes the blanket operator exclusion ONLY for these demonstrated unmeasured eight coverage checks; no replacement acquisition, source resurvey, global audit or unchanged scientific rerun.
